en.headline: ICAC charges Greentown's then chairman over alleged bribe
en.dek: Zhang Yadong, 58, appeared at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Friday over a 20 million dollar payment tied to a Dalian deal.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged the then chairman of Greentown China Holdings on Friday with one count of conspiracy for an agent to accept an advantage, and he appeared at Eastern Magistrates' Courts the same morning.

Zhang Yadong, 58, is accused of conspiring between January 2020 and March 2023 with a middleman, a shareholder of a Dalian property developer and his son, among others, to accept 20 million Hong Kong dollars from that shareholder. The ICAC said the alleged payment was to cause Greentown China to acquire the developer's equity.

Investigators said the shareholder had been pitching a Dalian project to Greentown China since 2019. Zhang is accused of soliciting the payment through the middleman, after which the listed company bought the project for 440 million yuan. The commission said the money was suspected to have been paid in several transfers into a bank account held by Zhang's son.

The charge is brought under section 9(1)(a) of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance and section 159A of the Crimes Ordinance. The ICAC said Greentown China gave full assistance during the investigation. Zhang has been charged and has not been convicted.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴綠城中國時任主席張亞東涉收賄2000萬
zh.dek: 58歲張亞東周五在東區裁判法院提訊，被控串謀使代理人接受利益，涉一宗大連項目。
body: 廉政公署周五落案起訴綠城中國控股有限公司時任主席張亞東，控告他一項串謀使代理人接受利益罪。案件同日早上在東區裁判法院提訊。
廉署稱，現年58歲的張亞東涉嫌於2020年1月至2023年3月期間，與一名中間人、一名大連房地產開發商股東及其兒子等人串謀，向該名股東收受2000萬港元，致使綠城中國取得該開發商的股權。
調查指，涉案股東自2019年起已向綠城中國推銷大連一個房地產項目，其後張亞東涉嫌透過中間人向該股東索賄，促成公司以4.4億元人民幣購入項目。廉署稱，賄款懷疑由中間人分多筆存入張亞東兒子的銀行戶口。
控罪根據《防止賄賂條例》第9(1)(a)條及《刑事罪行條例》第159A條提出。廉署表示，綠城中國在調查期間提供全面協助。張亞東已被起訴，案件仍待法院審理，他未被定罪。
